title: ID0427628-DC/Si-D/BE-[Multiple] Home Screen unavailable
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Since the new firmware update, the home screen is no longer
active on these charging stations. The home screen contains the
language selection, price/kWh and the required company info that
must be listed. You can find the configuration of this on the
chargers where firmware version 6.0 is active.
Please activate the home screen again and take this into account
when I ask you to update the other chargers to the new firmware
as well

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0427628-DC/Si-D/BE-[Multiple] Home Screen unavailable CRM:02679000337
additional_info.body:
Dear Chloë,
Thank you for your message.Yes, the idle screen has been eliminated in the new firmware to streamline the screen flow and reduce the number of steps required before charging begins. If no screensaver is selected, the system now defaults directly to the outlet selection screen.
Regarding language selection, users can now choose their preferred language from the menu located at the top right corner of the screen.
We fully understand the importance of adhering to local legal requirements, especially where non-compliance may result in significant fines. If displaying the idle screen is critical for compliance in your region, we can support a downgrade to the previous firmware version where the idle screen functionality is still available.
Please let us know how you'd like to proceed or if you require assistance with the downgrade process.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
